-- Leads table: indexes for all common filter/sort columns
ALTER TABLE leads
  ADD INDEX idx_leads_stage (stage),
  ADD INDEX idx_leads_assigned_to (assignedTo),
  ADD INDEX idx_leads_lead_source (leadSource),
  ADD INDEX idx_leads_meta_form_id (metaFormId),
  ADD INDEX idx_leads_created_at (createdAt),
  ADD INDEX idx_leads_updated_at (updatedAt),
  ADD INDEX idx_leads_last_contact_at (lastContactAt),
  ADD INDEX idx_leads_priority (priority),
  ADD INDEX idx_leads_interested_program (interestedProgram),
  ADD INDEX idx_leads_phone (phone),
  ADD INDEX idx_leads_email (email),
  ADD INDEX idx_leads_full_name (fullName);

-- lead_activities: index on leadId for fast join/filter when opening a lead profile
ALTER TABLE lead_activities
  ADD INDEX idx_lead_activities_lead_id (leadId),
  ADD INDEX idx_lead_activities_created_at (createdAt);
